summary: 7 of 7 yes on the round-2 re-shoot (a11r2_main). Armies colour-distinct at t0 (beta red/copper R/B 2.96, alpha white/grey/blue R/B 1.31); lines meet 2-4 m from x = 0 by t300 (contact at screen column ~915-940, 960 = x 0); visibly thinner at t900/t1440 (563 and 85 in frame); feet on the ground (sim height 0, mesh bottoms at z 0.00 cm, boots on the projected pivots); both CommandCentres in the overview; uniform scale, yaw-only rotation.
